decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

Prior to the commencement of the development (excluding demolition works), full details of the secure cycle storage facilities shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority which shall show their positioning within the site, the size and materials of the enclosure and the means of access. The approved details shall be implemented on site prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter permanently retained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the development provides an adequate level of cycle parking facilities and to encourage sustainable modes of transport, in accordance with Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018. This condition is required to be pre-commencement as cycle storage needs to be designed into the scheme at a early stage of the construction process and respect the materials and design of the development.
Any vehicle parked on the garage forecourt should not be allowed to overhang the highway boundary as to do so without lawful authority may be an offence against section 137 of the Highway Act 1980.

Prior to the commencement of development, details of proposed on-site renewable technologies must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing which demonstrates how the proposed renewable technology willachieve at least a 10% reduction in regulated and unregulated carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from the proposed dwelling.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to first occupation, documentary evidence that the approved renewable energy technology has been implemented as part of the completed development must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. All of the approved renewable energy measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to first occupation of the development, a completed Water Efficiency Calculator for New Dwellings must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that internal potable water consumption for each dwelling will be limited to no more than 110 litres per person per day (l/p/d) based on the Government's national calculation method for the purposes of Part G of the Building Regulations.Reason: To comply with Policy 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Safety Strategy by BPM Architecture. Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

The annexe  hereby permitted shall be only used for purposes ancillary and incidental to the main dwelling and for no other purposes. It shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 8 Rosswood Gardens.  It shall at no time be used as a separate residential unit. To ensure the ancillary nature it shall at no time have;i) a separate postal address, iii) separate metres for the provision of services,iv) a separate and registered Land Registry title,v) a separate Council tax account,vi) a separate access independent of the main dwelling house.Reason:  To ensure the ancillary nature of the outbuilding hereby permitted is not used as a separate unit of residential accommodation or for purposes other than that incidental to the enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse in accordance with policy 9 and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan.
